purpose: Bounded read-only finished-page review of the accepted specification-driven request explorer and raw response inspector.

authority.acceptanceLimit: Phase5 explicitly accepted source only; lint exit 0, style exit 1 with three inherited geometry candidates, Vitest startup exit 1 with zero cases and capture exit 2 are historical receipts, not fresh passes.
authority.applicationFiles: READ ONLY; no source, tests, catalogs, configuration or orchestrator files changed.

timebox.creationEvidence: Timestamp accompanying the actual task dispatch; not a queue reservation timestamp.
timebox.boundedCommands: All own commands completed synchronously; none exceeded the eight-minute command ceiling. No spawn or timeout wrappers.
timebox.stopHandling: On STOP, return immediately with retained report/WIP and release all ownership; no post-return writes.

acceptanceMeaning.PASS: Only the specifically named inspected-source or executed-document check is proven. It does not certify native behavior.
acceptanceMeaning.FAIL: A source-proven behavior or contract gap, with exact mechanism and deterministic source-derived reproduction. No live reproduction was executed.
acceptanceMeaning.NOTRUN: No applicable execution evidence; absence of authorization, not a pass or failed native test.

checkSummary.scope: Root individual checks only; excludes the seven separately listed endpoint agreements.

checks.name: Existing item and source-only predecessor authority
checks.detail: Reviewed the existing exact report-only item and accepted Phase5 row. No predecessor redispatch, implementation or completion-gate claim.

checks.name: Actual route and shared scope ownership
checks.detail: Lazy SafeRoute mount is /api-playground. Header vehicle selection is intentionally disabled. Page has no competing workspace date/vehicle selector; endpoint parameters are independent request inputs.

checks.name: Specification request route, cancellation and client prefix
checks.detail: GET /system/openapi is registered under /api/v1/system. The text/YAML request omits the client prefix, forwards the query cancellation signal and preserves the existing key and infinite staleTime.

checks.name: Explorer parsing, search and selection do not execute requests
checks.detail: Five supported methods, local parameter/schema references, first-tag grouping, defaults/examples and sorted operations remain. Search uses path/summary/operationId; selection and replay only select/clear response, never call executeRequest.

checks.name: Initial, fatal, authoritative empty and no-selection source branches
checks.detail: Source-shaped skeletons, fatal-only QueryError/retry, successful no-endpoint EmptyState/reload and workspace selection prompt exist. Unknown specification metrics are undefined; valid empty specification counts are zero, not invented measurements.

checks.name: Retained and offline specification source handling
checks.detail: The page does not pass a global loading/error replacement. Retained endpoints remain after refresh failure; deriveDataState marks stale and the shared nonblocking source notice distinguishes refresh failure from paused/offline with retry. Independent history summary stays mounted.

checks.name: Specification and local history trust are not conflated
checks.detail: Two independent OperationalBrief summaries explain source/scope. No server-wide traffic or observation timestamp is invented. Empty local history has known count zero and missing average latency; latency milliseconds are divided by 1000 only at the metric display boundary.

checks.name: Deliberate method-level confirmation and local optional API key
checks.detail: Every supported non-GET opens an explicit Yes/Cancel alert before onSend. Key is password-input/component state and only an explicit X-API-Key header; existing authHeaders is reused. This proves confirmation presence, not live-mode safety, authorization or paid-operation protection; see AP003/N07.

checks.name: Raw HTTP errors and malformed/non-JSON responses remain inspectable
checks.detail: Non-2xx HTTP responses are returned rather than replaced by thrown status errors. Response status/text, exposed headers, raw text, JSON/null/false/zero payloads and byte size remain. Invalid JSON falls back to original text. Duration measures time to response headers, not full body download.

checks.name: Raw SI inspector and existing presentation preferences
checks.detail: The JSON inspector preserves wire field names and raw SI values, rather than silently converting payloads or invoking deprecated unit helpers. Operational metrics use existing preference-aware display formatting. Network-error synthetic zero metadata is separately flagged AP005.

checks.name: Metadata-only history cap and non-executing template replay
checks.detail: New saved entries contain method, query-stripped path, HTTP status, duration and timestamp only; no API key, request body or response payload. Save caps at 20. Replay prefers exact same-method route then nonempty template match and never auto-sends. Loading persisted metadata still needs validation, AP006.

checks.name: Seven bounded source-pattern checks
checks.detail: Corrected case-sensitive raw controls 0; inline style openings 0; direct recharts/react-leaflet/framer-motion imports 0; old API imports 0; request/apiUrl double-prefix literals 0; four prohibited camelCase query assignments 0; neon/glow patterns 0 across seven exact production files. These narrow regex results are not a complete styling or dynamic-URL audit.

checks.name: Canonical English static translation-key existence
checks.detail: Executed lookup of 56 unique static t keys across the seven exact production files and AdminSummary: missing 0. This does not certify cold namespace loading, every prose string, plurals, every locale, RTL or text overflow; auxiliary literals remain C05.

checks.name: Current line and capability preservation against recorded original

All eight named capabilities remain. Current and recorded original GlassPanel/ChartContainer openings are page 0, composed 6; four page section openings, two summaries, one Card and one selection-prompt LayoutCard remain. Body textarea and selected endpoint state fail separately AP007/AP008. Prior audit cancellation and missing-region-busy findings are not carried forward.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-021; mission forms and request validation
confirmedIssues.mechanism: required is used only for a visual query asterisk; neither field required/error props nor any validation branch precede onSend. Blank path values retain braces, parameter type is only a placeholder, and arbitrary body text is passed through without JSON/schema feedback. Parsed body schema exists but requestBody.required and scalar bounds/enum constraints are not retained for validation.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: In a network-free RequestBuilder harness with onSend as a spy, supply the real GET /vehicles/{vehicleID}/state schema, leave vehicleID blank and invoke Send: the callback receives /vehicles/{vehicleID}/state. For a JSON-body POST endpoint, body text '{' still reaches the callback after confirmation. No actual Send or harness was run.
confirmedIssues.limit: Proves absent frontend validation/feedback, not backend acceptance of invalid input. The playground may deliberately support negative-response inspection; preserve that purpose instead of imposing an unrequested blanket ban.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: A narrow claimed followup should resolve intentional-invalid-request policy and expose accessible schema/validation feedback without removing raw HTTP inspection.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-045 endpoint agreement and request-value preservation
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Path values are inserted verbatim; only query values use encodeURIComponent. '/', '?' and '#' can change URI structure rather than represent one parameter value. The replacer-function dollar-token fix does not encode URI delimiters.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: For /vehicles/{vehicleID}/state, enter the synthetic value 7?debug=1. URL construction yields /vehicles/7?debug=1/state, not a state endpoint with a single encoded parameter. Entering a/b creates an extra route segment. This is a source-derived string result, not a network response.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim the existing URL builder/tests and preserve literal-dollar behavior while defining single-segment encoding and valid parameter constraints.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-046: commands/mutations remain live-only, not enabled in historical/offline views
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Interactive raw fetch never invokes the existing operational-mode/offline write guards. RequestBuilder gates only on method confirmation and loading. Unlike useWakeVehicle's requiresLiveMode:true, the same POST /vehicles/{vehicleID}/wake selected in this page is not rejected for an as_of URL or offline mode before transport.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: In a network-free harness, give the window an as_of timestamp, select POST /vehicles/{vehicleID}/wake with a synthetic ID, and use a mocked fetch that records but never sends. After Yes, the transport would be reached instead of throwing OperationalModeWriteError. Offline mode likewise has no preflight guard. No harness, wake or other mutation was executed.
confirmedIssues.limit: This is a frontend live-only boundary gap, not proof of a server authorization bypass, successful mutation, fee, offline queue or disabled backend middleware.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: A narrow transport/operational-mode followup must preserve raw non-JSON/error inspection while applying existing live-only guards before unsafe sends.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Selection and replay remain enabled during a request, clear response and change the request endpoint, but do not invalidate the in-flight response generation or cancel it. The pending handleSend later unconditionally writes result/error and clears loading. ResponseViewer has no request identity. Snippet uses the old lastRequestRef while RequestBuilder shows the new selection.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: With executeRequest deferred by a network-free mock: select A, Send A, select B before resolving A, then resolve A with distinctive payload. B's workspace receives A's status/body and A's snippet because handleSelect did not retire A and setResponse has no identity check. Replaying B during A has the same mechanism.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim the page/transport tests for a selection/request-generation or explicit attributed-response policy; preserve network-free selection/replay and raw response history.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-025/MDC-026: only confirmed success uses success semantics; unknown is not measured zero
confirmedIssues.mechanism: A rejected transport creates status 0 plus Network error, duration 0 and size 0. Both statusColor and statusBg classify every value below 300 as green success, so the network error is green and its unavailable metadata is rendered as measured 0ms/0 B.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: Feed ResponseViewer the exact page catch-path ApiResponse with status:0/statusText:'Network error'. Its status bar uses text-green-400 and green background/border; duration and size format as zero. Equivalently a mocked rejected transport enters this branch. No live network failure was induced.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim response metadata/presentation tests; distinguish transport failure from HTTP status ranges and unknown metadata from real zero.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-046 persisted source trust and null safety
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Syntactically valid stored JSON is asserted to HistoryEntry[] without array/entry validation or a load-time cap. The try/catch catches parse failure, not valid wrong shapes. Null causes history.length to throw; an object causes history.reduce to throw before the page returns its content. Arrays with invalid entries can also fail aggregation/rendering.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: In isolated synthetic session storage, put 'null' or '{}' at teslasync-api-playground-history and mount the page with API reads mocked. loadHistory returns the wrong shape, and historyStats fails at .length or .reduce. Storage and mount were not touched during this review.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim the existing persistence helper/tests; validate/filter bounded metadata at load while preserving key, order, metadata-only privacy and exact/template replay.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: UiTextarea receives no label, aria-label, aria-labelledby or associated explicit ID. Its preceding request-body h4 does not label the generated textarea ID. The primitive only renders an associated label when label is supplied.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: Render RequestBuilder for a body-bearing endpoint without any network activity. The textarea cannot be located by the visible localized Request body label; the generated textarea has no explicit label association. The JSON placeholder does not associate the visible heading or satisfy the visible-label contract.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim RequestBuilder/tests; use the existing Textarea label/name API and retain body/content-type context.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-040 selected state must not be conveyed only through visual color
confirmedIssues.mechanism: isSelected changes only background/border classes. Endpoint buttons expose neither aria-pressed/current/selected nor textual selected state. Group expanded state is correctly exposed, but that does not communicate which operation is selected.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: Render two endpoint buttons, select one, and inspect their props/accessibility state in a network-free harness: method/path names persist but only CSS distinguishes the selected endpoint. This inspection was source-only, not a screen-reader run.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim endpoint selector/tests; expose appropriate selected semantics without inventing a new picker or auto-sending.

confirmedIssues.rule: Preserve useful, correct four-format generated snippets
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The Python branch inserts raw JSON body text directly after json=. Valid JSON true/false/null are not Python True/False/None, so ordinary valid JSON bodies produce undefined Python names before the HTTP call.
confirmedIssues.deterministicRepro: Given synthetic body {"enabled":true,"optional":null}, Python snippet text contains json={"enabled":true,"optional":null}. Evaluating the keyword argument would raise NameError for true rather than issue a request. Only source/string reasoning was used; no generated snippet was executed.
confirmedIssues.parentNeed: Claim the existing snippet generator/tests for JSON-safe Python rendering, retaining all four formats, raw values and secret exclusion.

candidatesNotNativeFailures.detail: Nonwrapping confirmation row combines explanation and two actions; fixed w-28 parameter/auth labels share rows with inputs. Narrow width, long translation and 200% text can squeeze controls; actual clipping/overflow NOTRUN.
Four snippet-format controls plus Copy are in one nonwrapping toolbar. Mobile/large-text fit and all-format reachability NOTRUN.
Explorer and snippet/header/history controls override Button height/padding with !h-auto and compact classes. Actual 44px mobile target bounds and any spacing exceptions NOTRUN.

Three inherited arbitrary geometry utilities remain on two matching lines: xl:grid-cols-[20rem_minmax(0,1fr)], h-[26rem], xl:h-[calc(100vh-13rem)]. They remain unaccepted candidates from Phase5 style exit 1, not scanner exemptions or native failures. No new scanner run.

Auxiliary default-parameter hint, generated authentication comments and fallback Other are literal English. Static t-key existence does not cover these strings. Confirm localization policy for technical generated-code comments and exercise actual non-English endpoints before claiming full localization.

Raw inspector does not attach the shared cached sudo token or invoke the client challenge flow. Backend sudo remains enforced at registered routes; actual auth mode/challenge behavior NOTRUN. Do not equate this source observation with authorization bypass.

Parser uses operation parameters only and transport forces application/json for bodies. Path-level inherited parameters/non-JSON request bodies require a concrete supported endpoint before raising an additional product defect; no speculative form/upload implementation requested.

Other snippet branches insert URL/body literals without language-specific escaping. Concrete quote/backtick edge cases and copied-command correctness were not executed; never run a generated command against production as QA.
